title: GoT-CD: Graph-of-Thoughts Causal Discovery and the Fragility of Post-hoc Path-Specific Fairness Audits

bias_targets.methodology: Post-hoc path-specific counterfactual fairness audits on discovered causal graphs, calculating path-specific effects (PSE) and evaluating the structural recovery of the designated unfair pathway from the protected attribute (Sex) to the outcome (MOCA Score).
